audience_and_scope.audience: the workload's registered audiences narrowed to the credential row's own audiences; the requested audience must be in both, and an empty intersection is refused
audience_and_scope.resource_binding: the credential_registry row's principal: one registered platform workload
audience_and_scope.tenant_binding: none: a platform workload acts for no organization

backing_store.store: Postgres auth.credential_registry: the SHA-256 digest of the whole value (secret_hash, hash_algorithm sha256), never the value

bootstrap.local_compose: The workload reads its value from a restricted secret file and presents it to the exchange (AUTH_WORKLOAD_BOOTSTRAP=true); the Compose file mount is a separate leaf
bootstrap.production: Not used: Kubernetes workloads exchange their projected ServiceAccount token (kubernetes_sa_token_exchange)

consumers.description: POST /internal/v1/token/exchange (auth-service, mounted with AUTH_WORKLOAD_BOOTSTRAP=true): the RFC 8693 subject_token with subject_token_type urn:dev-health:params:oauth:token-type:workload-bootstrap, exchanged for a workload_token

display_name: Compose bootstrap credential presented to the auth-service workload-token exchange

issuer.description: An operator creates it once for one workload; the value is output once and only its digest is stored (the create, rotate, revoke and disable verbs are a separate leaf)

audit_source.description: Refusals are logged and counted by reason only (auth.workload.exchanges, subject bootstrap); an issued exchange writes auth.workload.token_issued naming the credential row id (credential_id), never the value

revocation.description: A revoked, expired or disabled-workload credential refuses the next exchange: the registry row is read on every call and nothing is cached

rotation.description: Bounded-overlap rotation: a new row with the old row as rotation parent and an expiry on the old one (the lifecycle verbs are a separate leaf); an issued token never outlives the credential's expiry

transport.header_or_cookie: POST /internal/v1/token/exchange, form field subject_token (Content-Type application/x-www-form-urlencoded, RFC 8693, subject_token_type urn:dev-health:params:oauth:token-type:workload-bootstrap); never an Authorization header

validators.description: handler.serveBootstrap: the shape is checked first (no store read for any other value), then the SHA-256 digest is resolved by workload.Store.ResolveBootstrap: class workload_bootstrap_credential, platform-owned, unrevoked, before its expiry, an enabled workload principal, and an audience shared by the workload and the credential
